title: Chocolate Sandwich Cookie Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Crushed chocolate sandwich cookies cooked into the custard and strained out, with chopped cookies folded in; less sugar.
summary: A version of our classic custard where crushed chocolate sandwich cookies are cooked into the base and strained out, then more chopped cookies are folded through. The base tastes deeply of the cookies.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt in the saucepan, then whisk in the crushed cookies, milk and cream. Cooking with the crumbs pulls their cocoa flavour right into the custard.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir over low heat, scraping constantly, for about 10 min until steaming, thickened and 77-80 °C. The crumbs make it look thick early, so check the thermometer.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Sieve into a bowl, pressing gently on the crumbs to release the liquid, then stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool over the iced water and refrigerate for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn and fold
steps.text: Churn until thick, then fold in the chopped cookies with the spatula.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 4 h until scoopable.

tips: Crush the cookies in a freezer bag with a rolling pin; filling and all.
A common mistake is pressing the crumbs too hard in the sieve, which pushes grit into the base. Press gently.
Freeze the chopped cookies before folding in so they stay crisp longer.
storage: Freeze in a covered container for up to 2 weeks; the cookie pieces soften slowly.
